---
title: "Data Summary"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}
data("msleep")
glimpse(msleep)
```

To describe the range,centrality and variance of the data

```{r}
min(msleep$awake)
max(msleep$awake)
mean(msleep$awake)
median(msleep$awake)
var(msleep$awake)
IQR(msleep$awake)
```

The box plot can be used to confirm the median of the points

```{r}
ggplot(msleep,aes(x=msleep$awake))+
  geom_boxplot(color="brown",fill="white")+
  theme_bw()

```

To get the whole summary of your data

```{r}
summary(msleep)

```

To get a summary of only two varaibles

```{r}
msleep %>% 
  select(brainwt,bodywt) %>% 
  summary()

```

For the category vore we are supposed to generate a table summary

First let's select the variables sleep_total and vore

```{r}
vore_data <- msleep %>% 
  select(vore,sleep_total) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  print()

```

Now for each category we need to find a summary in terms of a table

```{r}
vore_data %>% 
  group_by(vore) %>% 
  summarise(sleeping_total=sum(sleep_total),average_total = mean(sleep_total),max_sleep=max(sleep_total),min_sleep=min(sleep_total)) %>% 
  arrange(-average_total)
```

Creating contingency table

```{r}
library(MASS)

```

Now using the Cars93 dataset

```{r}
data("Cars93")
glimpse(Cars93)
attach(Cars93)

```

Creating a table summary for Airbags and Origin

```{r}
table(AirBags,Origin)

```

To create row and column totals to the table

```{r}
addmargins(table(AirBags,Origin))

```

To get the proportion of our observations

```{r}
prop.table(table(AirBags,Origin))*100

```

To get the row observations per each category

```{r}
prop.table(table(AirBags,Origin),1)*100

```
